messages:
maya: Quick sync — putting a compact GA gates checklist here for Redwood Optimize rollout. Need owners and ETA for SLA, docs, support runbook, monitoring/alerts, pricing updates. Reply with one-liners and ETA. :eyes:

liam: For SLA I think we should require p95 < 120ms for small batch gen, p95 < 250ms for high-concurrency cases. Who owns measurement?

sofia: I can own monitoring and alerts. Will add the dashboards and alert rules to the Console. Plan: dashboards by EOD Thu, alert runbook draft Fri.

raj: Pricing page updates: need two SKUs (standard/priority) + burst add-on. I can draft copy and tier examples. ETA Monday for initial PR.

liam: Measurement owner: liam (infra). ETA: end of week to instrument token-level latency breakdown and synthetic jobs. Will post the scripts.

maya: Great. SLA doc stub below — please confirm numbers and rollback/fallback behavior.

maya: ```
SLA: Redwood Optimize GA
- Availability: 99.9% uptime (control plane + inference path)
- Latency: p95 < 120ms (standard), p95 < 250ms (burst/high-concurrency)
- Error rate: >= 99.95% success rate (2xx)
Fallbacks: automatic routing to compatible quantized variant, degrade to lower throughput but preserve success rate.
```

liam: Confirming numbers look reasonable. Need to make sure we have graceful fallback implemented and tested. I'll add a canary job that simulates capacity loss and validates routing. ETA Tue.

sofia: Monitoring checklist (short):
- Console dashboard: latency by model/route/token-class
- Error budget metric + burn rate alert
- KV/prefix cache hit rate panel
- Canary job synthetic traces
ETA: dashboards Thu, alerts Fri.

maya: Docs & runbook owners? Ops runbook should include escalation matrix and playbook for fallback triggers.

raj: I'll pair with an SE to craft pricing examples; also will put a callout for Dedicated vs Hosted pricing differences. Need PM review on margin targets.

ops-bot: New runbook template created: <https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/optimize-ga>. Please fill in playbook steps and post back when ready.

maya: Support scope: first-line triage owned by Support Tier 2 (SEs), oncall routing to infra-oncall for incidents impacting SLA. Sofia to add routing docs.

liam: Technical checklist snippets I'll push to the repo:

```
# smoke test snippet
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# validate p95 from synthetic harness
```

sofia: Also adding regression alerts tied to evals (quality monitoring). If model output quality drops vs baseline, trigger QA review + hold rollout. ETA: next Wed.

maya: Risks to call out:
- Observability gaps for tail latency on long-context requests
- Pricing complexity causing billing confusion
- Fallback correctness for model-variant routing
Please add mitigations inline.

liam: Mitigations: add headroom-based routing tests, run long-context canaries, and add specific trace tags for KV cache events.

raj: For pricing confusion: include a simple worked example on the pricing page and a cost-estimator spreadsheet. I'll own both.

maya: Final owners summary (please confirm or edit):
- SLA & metrics: liam (infra)
- Monitoring & alerts: sofia (TPM)
- Runbook & support routing: maya (PM) + support ops (TBD)
- Pricing copy & examples: raj (growth)
- Docs + public-facing page: maya + raj

maya: If everyone confirms, I'll convert this into a formal GA gates checklist and kick off a review with Legal/Support/Eng next Tue. :white_check_mark:

liam: Confirmed.

sofia: Confirmed — will post dashboards/alerts links when ready.

raj: Confirmed, drafting pricing doc now.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: review meeting in #calendar on 2150010600 (Tue).
